## 1. Professional Overview

Karthick A is a Generative AI Engineer and Python Backend Developer with a completed Bachelor of Science (BSc) degree in Computer Science from A M Jain College in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, and 3 months of experience as a Generative AI Intern at CFRS.

His engineering work focuses on production-ready artificial intelligence systems and high-throughput Python backends:
- **Atlas (https://atlas.karthicka.me)**: An autonomous AI GitHub code reviewer that connects via GitHub App OAuth, audits codebases for race conditions and vulnerabilities using LangGraph 3-node state graphs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, and generates surgical 1-click pull request patches.
- **RAG Knowledge Engine**: Production-ready document question-answering microservices using FastAPI, LangChain, and ChromaDB with citation-backed generation to eliminate hallucinations.
- **Sana AI (https://sana.karthicka.me)**: Real-time, voice-enabled AI companion with sub-second conversational latency using faster-whisper, Groq inference, and ElevenLabs streaming synthesis.

## 4. Comprehensive Technical Skill Matrix

### 4.1 AI Engineering & Autonomous Agents
- **Autonomous Agent Workflows**: Compiling multi-node cyclical workflows (`discover_topology` -> `security_audit` -> `patch_generation`) for autonomous code review and vulnerability discovery.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Custom MCP server & client integrations, tool execution (`read_file`, `search_code`), and AST symbol discovery across 100,000+ file git trees.
- **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)**: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter, dense embeddings, ChromaDB vector indexing, cosine similarity lookups, and citation-backed generation.
- **LLM Multi-Provider Cascading**: Zero-downtime routing between Groq (ultra-low latency), Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (1M context), and NVIDIA NIM with automatic fallback on rate limits.

### 4.2 APIs & Data Systems
- **Language**: Python (typing, Pydantic schemas), SQL
- **Frameworks**: FastAPI, Uvicorn, RESTful API architecture
- **Databases**: Turso (libSQL Edge DB over TLS 1.3), ChromaDB, MySQL, Supabase
- **Inference Architecture**: High-efficiency inference pipelines and response streaming

### 4.3 Audio & Voice AI

## 5. Key Projects & Technical Case Studies

### 5.1 Atlas — Autonomous AI GitHub Copilot & Code Intelligence
- **Live Platform**: https://atlas.karthicka.me
- **Stack**: Python 3.13, FastAPI, LangChain, Turso libSQL, GitHub App OAuth
- **Architecture**:
  - GitHub App integration for secure token-level repository access.
  - Recursive git tree traversal that parses directory structure in under 1 second without full repository cloning.
  - Multi-stage autonomous workflow running automated security scans for OWASP top 10 vulnerabilities.
  - Surgical MCP tools reading exact file line ranges (`read_file(start_line, end_line)`).
  - 1-Click Pull Request creation that computes unified git diffs, provisions branches, and opens ready-to-merge PRs on GitHub.

### 5.2 Offline Multimodal RAG — Air-Gapped Knowledge Engine
- **Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Ollama (mistral-nemo), ChromaDB, SentenceTransformers (nomic-embed-text-v1.5), faster-whisper
- **Architecture**:
  - 100% air-gapped multimodal RAG pipeline executing fully offline on local CPU/GPU hardware.
  - Multi-format ingestion pipeline extracting text and tables from PDFs, DOCX, CSV/XLSX, and transcribing audio recordings via faster-whisper with precise timestamp tracking.
  - Local embedding engine using nomic-embed-text-v1.5 with task prefixing (`search_document`, `search_query`) and ChromaDB vector indexing.
  - Local LLM inference powered by Ollama (mistral-nemo) with an 8,192-token context window.
  - Deep citation provenance linking synthesized answers to verifiable source locators (exact page numbers, timestamps, and cosine similarity match scores) to eliminate hallucinations.

### 5.3 Sana — Real-Time Voice AI Companion
- **Live Platform**: https://sana.karthicka.me
- **Stack**: Python, FastAPI, Three.js, Groq, ElevenLabs, faster-whisper
- **Architecture**:
  - End-to-end voice loop maintaining sub-second conversational latency.
  - Streaming speech synthesis via ElevenLabs with audio buffer queuing.
  - Persistent multi-turn dialogue memory and emotional expression tagging driving 3D avatar animations.
